title: FMS - TMDE Signal Generator
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND.AIR FORCE SUSTAINMENT CENTER.FA8517  AFSC PZAAC
description_text: This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commerical products prepared in accordance with the format in subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This annoucement constitutes the only solicitation; proposals are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued. This is a FMS requirement for a commercial, sole source, one (1) time purchase for a RF/Microwave Signal Generator. This procurement is to acquire one NSN 6625-01-674-4455; Part Number: MG36241A, Signal Generator for an FMS customer. The Signal Generator is Air Force Precision Measurement Equipment Laboratories (PMEL) preferred item. This will be a one (1) time purchase order, with firm fixed pricing. Please read the attachment and its entirety. Submission procedures below. Supplies/Service Description Quantity Unit Signal Generator; P/N: MG36241A 1 Each *All inquiries and response must be submitted to Latonya Jackson NLT 21 MAY 2026 at 4pm (EST).
